evidence: The accepted v36 evaluation at 12b580fd16db4d603164821a223688d1d9167cdc reports v36-quest-ran-goal at 19/60 matching screens and cursors, 2825/3880 RNG calls, with the missing Ran-goal loader at step 19. The recording SHA256 is d91dd644166bac1a96f924062f216997268a1824a2b8e5902a66cde930a446ad and manifest SHA256 is 58332ee9786ee7c91f282d2fe29ca64fc6ee5e23ca70f0261bbedd7ea88fd20c. The subsequent Ran-loca integration does not alter this source or loader key; the cached Ran-goal row remains the current diagnosis.

Read all 106 lines of dat/Ran-goal.lua, SHA256 cbe9d0f03ad0ba49e6a31611d03d382601ba9fcb7053aa84787522fe2226bfe5. It solid-fills stone, sets mazelevel, defines an exact 76x20 map, selects the full map lit, places the up stair at (19,10), marks the full map non-diggable, then performs object, trap, door, monster, and wallify calls in source order.

Lines 39-60 place a blessed +0 bow named The Longbow of Diana and a chest at (37,10), eight random objects at fixed neighboring coordinates, five additional random objects, and six random traps. Existing mklev object adapters preserve map-relative coordinates; sp_lev_object resolves descriptors and applies buc/spe/name, calling nameObject -> oname with ONAME_LEVEL_DEF. Artifact naming for the Longbow of Diana already exists.

Lines 62-75 define fourteen door descriptors in order. Lines 77-104 define twenty-eight hostile monsters in order: Scorpius; six fixed forest centaurs; six fixed mountain centaurs; two random forest centaurs; two random mountain centaurs; two C-class monsters; six fixed scorpions; two random scorpions; and one s-class monster. Existing lspo_monster/get_table_montype/get_table_monclass resolve these species and class tables. The program ends with des.wallify at line 106.

Production wiring belongs in js/quest_levels.js. mklev.js:load_special imports and dispatches QUEST_LEVEL_LOADERS for makelevel/makemaz; wizcmds.js:wiz_load_splua reaches the same load_special owner. Add only the Ran-goal loader key and implementation. No supporting descriptor-owner, generic loader, or shared contract change is required by this source.
